semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Full Bright Industrial Supply Center provides precision manufacturing and measurement technology that supports semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Full Bright Industrial Supply Center specializes in high-precision manufacturing and metrology solutions, offering advanced machine tools and measuring instruments critical for semiconductor production. Established in 1974, the company emphasizes professionalism, quality, and service to enhance operational efficiency for its customers.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Full Bright Industrial Supply Center is based in Taiwan and has been operating since 1974.
